notes: Zone bl_ground: the paving round Blanton Hall inside this area. Blanton Hall itself is the main model's (an OpenStreetMap extrusion, way 313029108, walls down to 135.83 m) and stays; the ground under it is this area's and is hidden. Most of what lies outside the walls is hidden in the 2020 ortho by the hall's leaning roof (5 to 8 m to the north-west), so the layout comes from the LiDAR (NJ NW 6-County 2017, class-2 ground in 0.5 m cells and profiles every 10 m), the neighbours' surfaces that meet the outline (webster: the plaza, Lot 17, the west walks; north-east: Webster Road and the Stone Street apron) and OpenStreetMap footways; every surface is UNVERIFIED. Where a neighbour's lawn meets the outline (the east end, the west end between the walks, the stretch x 121 to 141 of the north-west edge, which here is walk) the ground is this area's soft ground (lawn). Every surface is 'grade': false and follows the LiDAR ground (blurred over 1 m): graded, its cells (some under the hall, where the ground is filled, not measured) joined the neighbours' grade and moved webster's plaza by up to 0.19 m and the north-east area's Webster Road by 0.20 m (pure-Python terrain against the merged branch); ungraded, their paving does not move. No markings: none can be seen. No curbs: the curb of Webster Road lies in the north-east area or on its edge. Generator: scratchpad blanton/gen.py (not in the repository); edit this file by hand from now on and say so here.
